book.name: EFESUS
book.title: Pol nember tup nal lenge Efesus

content: Ŋam Pol. O ŋasande kitikin Got pe, kin nalaŋatme ŋam taꞌe ŋaiye aposel tikin Jisas Krais. Tup eꞌe ŋam member mal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin Got ŋaiye yarp ya yoto moi embere Efesus ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime Jisas Krais.
Yai Got poi topoꞌe Lahmborenge Jisas Krais ka ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me yip, topoꞌe ka yende ŋoihmbwaip yip ka si ŋumwaiye.
Nato Krais pe, Got pwal poi ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore tikin moihlaꞌ
Ya hriphrip mahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got ŋaiye kin Yai tikin Lahmborenge poi Jisas Krais! Poi tongorꞌ mal Krais pe, Got pwal poi ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore tikin moihlaꞌ ŋaiye ka ungwisme yipihinge bwore poi.
Teter ŋaiye Got yukur ŋende kekep pe, kin si nalaŋatme poi ŋaiye ya murp moto Krais. Taꞌe luku pe, nato Krais ya murp yirise supule topoꞌe ya murp holi bwore mise supule mil ŋembep kin.
Kin ŋende nihararme poi pe, somohonme kin nalaŋatme poi ŋaiye ya murp tuꞌe talah kitikin mil moto Jisas Krais.
Poi ya lalme mahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got ŋaiye kin ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ me poi. Detale, Talah esep kin ilyeh uku, ŋaiye kin ŋende nihararme pe, kin pwal poi pakaiye.
Krais nule nal loutungwarmbe pe, hwap lalme ŋaiye poi mende pe, wim kin si nongohe miꞌe ko. Kin ŋende poi marp bwore hlaininge. Ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ tikin Got pe,
kin ŋembere supule. Topoꞌe Got pwal poi sande tekeꞌe, topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip bwore bwore kitikin natme poi.
Somohonme Got si ŋoiheryembe ŋai uku ŋaiye ka ende oto wah tikin Krais. Kom ŋoihmbwaip kin uku sai tase tatame ŋaiye tukwini kin si pasam poi.

Ŋup kitikin uku ka ot pe, Got ka uwilꞌe ember ŋoihmbwaip tase kitikin ŋaiye kin si ŋoiheryembe sai. Kin ka enge ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye sai nanah moihlaꞌ, topoꞌe nate gah kekep ote guhilyeh pe, Krais ka orp tuꞌe miyeꞌ ondoh.

Got se ka ende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme luku gunde ŋasande topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip kitikin. Got si nalaŋatme poi taꞌe miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin. Pe poi ya mil tongorꞌ mil Krais supule gunde ŋaiye somohonme kin ŋoiheryembe.
Poi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Juta pe, poi ŋendehei ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime Jisas pe, poi gwande kin. Poi ya mahraꞌe naŋ tikin Got mi moto bongol kin, topoꞌe yirise embere kin.

Topoꞌe ŋupe ŋaiye yip haiten yisande wusyep bwore mise tikin Got no, ŋoihmbwaip yip teŋeime Krais pe, wusyep bwore mise luku kin nungwisme yip. Miꞌe pe, Got nember wutuꞌ tikin Yohe Yirise gahanahme yip ŋaiye kin si ŋanange nalaŋatme.

Topoꞌe poi sisyeme ŋaiye mindemboi se ya mambaꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe bwore bwore lalme ŋaiye Got ŋanange nalaŋatme nange ka angange lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kin. Pe tinge ka yurp hlaininge. Detale, poi si mambaꞌe Yohe Yirise. Taꞌe luku pe, poi ya ŋoihmeryembe wah embere embere ŋaiye Got ŋende pe, ya mahraꞌe naŋ kin.
Pol ŋanange wusyep ŋisilihme Got ŋaiye ka angange sande tekeꞌe kitikin el lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Efesus
Ŋam masande wusyep nange ŋoihmbwaip yip teŋeime Lahmborenge Jisas, topoꞌe yip yende nihararme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme tikin Got.
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋam yukur masme ŋoihmbwaip ŋaiye ŋam manange wusyep hriphrip me Got me yip. Ŋam ŋoihmeryembe yip ŋupe ŋaiye ŋam manange wusyep topoꞌme Got.
Ŋam misilihme Got tikin Lahmborenge poi Jisas Krais. Kin Yai tikin yirise embere topoꞌe bongol supule. Kin ka yul yip sande tekeꞌe bwore ŋaiye pa sisyeme kin.

Ŋam misilihme Got ŋaiye ka oworꞌe ŋondoh yip no, yirise kin ka ote oto ŋondoh yip. Taꞌe luku pe, yip pa ŋoiheryembe ŋaimune ŋaiye kin nalaŋatme ŋaiye ka yul yip. Yip pa sisyeme ŋaimune bwore bwore ŋaiye Got si nalaŋatme sai me lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin.
Topoꞌe bongol embere tikin Got uku ŋaiye ŋende wah nato poi lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip poi teŋeime kin. Bongol uku, ki embere embere sekete.
Bongol ŋilyeh uku ŋaiye Got ŋahraꞌe Krais nasme nule pe, kin nember kin narp nal syep non kitikin nanah moihlaꞌ, ŋaiye ka hindi bepeteme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme.

Taꞌe luku pe, Krais narp nanah hlaꞌ supulme lenge yipihinge pupwa ŋaiye bongol, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ ondoh lalme, topoꞌe lenge gavman, topoꞌe lenge ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye tikin bongol. Kin narp nanah hlaꞌ me lenge yipihinge, topoꞌe lenge miyeꞌ lalme embere embere ŋaiye diꞌ naŋ tahar tahar tukwini leꞌe topoꞌe ŋaiye mindemboi boi.
Got nember ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme gah ŋihip tuweihe Jisas pe, kin ŋende kin narp miyeꞌ ondoh me ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme luku, topoꞌe kin miyeꞌ ondoh tikin sios.
Sios pe, ki wahriꞌ tikin Krais. Pe bongol tikin Krais ki paparar supule nalꞌe nalꞌe nato kekep lalme topoꞌe moihlaꞌ, topoꞌe kin nangange bongol kin uku nato sios kin lalme.
